title: Chocolate branco caramelizado
creator: crispimichele
statusNote: The method is only shown in the video. The steps are the usual method for caramelised white chocolate.
steps: Bake the chopped white chocolate on a tray at 120 °C, stirring every 10 minutes, until it turns a deep caramel colour (about 45–60 minutes).
Stir in the cream until smooth. Use as a filling or ganache.
